column1: # Corrections found by diffing our OCR against an independent transcription
# of the same episode (scripts/subs/cross-check.py). One per line: what the
# OCR read, then what it should say. Matched whole-word and case-insensitively,
# and the replacement keeps the original's leading capital.
# British spellings are NOT in here. The other transcription is American and
# says pedophile, finalized and resynchronize; ours are right and stay.
